verdict_msg: HARD_FAIL (M1 insufficient in this regime): no tau achieves gap-refuse>=0.95 without dropping in-coverage F1 >0.05 -- the substrate cannot separate present-gold-paraphrased from absent-gold by bge confidence alone (the categorical failure mode). Refuse-robustness needs more than a similarity threshold (composes with Cause-3 query-side work). M1 tau-gate on held-out (DECISION 34a). Ungated: in-cov-F1=0.0741, gap-refuse=0.0000. Sweep tau in [0.50,0.95]. HARD-PASS needs a tau with gap-refuse>=0.95 AND in-cov-F1 drop<=0.05. Best qualifying tau: NONE. NOTE: M1 is a SOUNDNESS-only fix (Cause 2); IN-COVERAGE is already ~0.074 (Cause 3 capability-transfer gap -- M1 does not fix it).
